verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only developer-facing building blocks for external agents: an MCP server used from the IDE, a Claude Code plugin, and a prompt library. None of these is an assistant built into the Mercado Pago product itself, and there is no evidence of one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
